chunks: From him, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Najrān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
If the woman becomes pure before sunset, then she should perform the ẓuhr and ʿaṣr prayers; and if she becomes pure at the end of the night, then she should perform the maghrib and ʿishāʾ prayers.

key_terms.آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ: the end portion of the night
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman addressed in the ruling
key_terms.غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ: sunset, marking the end of the daytime prayer period mentioned here

ai.seo_question: What prayers must a woman perform if she becomes pure before sunset or near the end of the night?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who becomes pure from menstruation or a similar state before the end of prayer times. It establishes that when purity is attained before sunset or at the end of the night, she must perform the prayers whose time remains accessible.
